author: avramovic
name: WebXR
shortDescription: WebXR VR core: session management, controllers, grab/climb/interact/holster/selectable/targetable. Archery, doors, and teleport are in separate extensions.
description: Complete WebXR VR framework for building immersive VR games.
- Track VR headset position and controller input in real-time
- Build interactive grabbable, climbable, selectable, and holster objects
- Detect laser-pointer aim on any 3D object with VrTargetable (no grabbable required)
- Customize world scale and spatial anchoring
- Archery, doors, and teleport are available as separate extensions (webxr_archery, webxr_doors, webxr_teleport)

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Controls how controller rays (the laser, magnetic grab, and ray selection) hit this specific object, overriding the default (a Physics3D body's shape if it has one, otherwise exact render triangles). Put this on a high-poly model that is slowing down controller aiming and set HitMode to Box so rays test its bounding box instead of every triangle, whether or not it has a Physics3D body. HitMode Physics restores the default handling, so SetHitMode can switch an object back at runtime without removing the behavior. Ignore makes controller rays pass straight through. Without this behavior, an object is hit at its default: Physics3D shape if it has a body, exact triangles otherwise, same as before 0.29.0.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: VrRayHitMode

eventsFunctions.description: Set how controller rays hit this object. Physics restores the default handling: a Physics3D body's shape if it has one, otherwise exact render triangles. Triangle tests exact render geometry, overriding a physics shape if present (can be slow on a high-poly model). Box tests only the object's bounding box, ignoring its triangle count, also overriding a physics shape if present. Ignore makes controller rays pass straight through, so it can no longer be aimed at, magnetically grabbed, or ray-selected.
eventsFunctions.name: SetHitMode

propertyDescriptors.label: Hit mode
propertyDescriptors.description: How controller rays hit this object: Physics (default handling: this object's Physics3D shape if it has one, otherwise exact render geometry, same as having no VrRayHitMode behavior), Triangle (exact render geometry, overriding a physics shape if present; can be slow on a high-poly model), Box (fast, tests only the bounding box, also overriding a physics shape if present), or Ignore (rays pass straight through). Example: put this on a detailed statue with a coarse Box physics collider and set HitMode to Triangle for exact laser hits; switch back to the collider at runtime with SetHitMode("Physics").
